answers.core: This is a quality of life improvement that can greatly reduce the time needed to prototype something. For example, a developer might not have any art assets on them right that instance, but adding this will enable them to quickly test out their idea before they incorporate their art.
answers.workaround: This can be easily worked around with having a placeholder texture, so like a 16x16 all-white texture.
